description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Use when an agent asks whether insiders are buying or selling a stock. Parsed Form 4: insider, role, code, shares, price, value, 10b5-1 flag, buy/sell totals. Returns JSON parsed Form 4 rows (insider, role, code, shares, price, value, 10b5-1 flag) and buy or sell totals.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

limit.description: Maximum Form 4 rows. Format: positive integer. Example: 20. Omit for the server's current cap.

open_market.description: When true, keep open-market buys and sells and drop other Form 4 codes. Format: boolean true or false. Example: true. Omit for every Form 4 code.

ticker.description: US stock ticker. Format: uppercase ticker. Example: NVDA. Required.

name: stock_insiders
title: Insider buys/sells from SEC Form 4 ($0.005)
